title: Join
summary: You apply, we talk, you pick a domain track. No test, no prerequisite, no gatekeeping.

title: Learn
summary: Weekly hands-on sessions in your track. Structured, sequenced, and taught by people one step ahead of you.

title: Build
summary: Your first real project, shipped publicly with a repository someone else could read and run.

title: Hackathons
summary: Competing under a clock with a team you did not choose. This is where the learning compounds fastest.

title: Leadership
summary: You run the sessions you once attended, author the challenges, and mentor the intake behind you.

title: Internship
summary: A portfolio, a competition record and a reference from someone in industry — the three things that open the first door.

title: Placement
summary: You interview with work to point at rather than a syllabus to recite.

title: Founder
summary: For some, the project becomes the company. The alumni network is here for that too.
